cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)

project(sshhelper_terminal C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The Android ABI-specific static library is generated by
# scripts/build-libghostty-android.sh into app/build/ghostty/<ABI>.
set(GHOSTTY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../build/ghostty")
set(GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB "${GHOSTTY_ROOT}/${ANDROID_ABI}/libghostty-vt.a")

if(NOT EXISTS "${GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "libghostty-vt static library not found: ${GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB}\n"
        "Run scripts/build-libghostty-android.sh first.")
endif()

add_library(sshhelper_terminal SHARED
    ghostty_terminal_jni.cpp
)

target_include_directories(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE
    "${GHOSTTY_ROOT}/include"
)

# libghostty-vt is built as a static archive. Linking it into our own shared
# library avoids shipping the upstream SONAME and keeps ABI control local.
target_link_libraries(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE
    "${GHOSTTY_STATIC_LIB}"
    log
)

target_compile_definitions(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE GHOSTTY_STATIC)

# Keep Android 15+ 16 KB page alignment deterministic even if the default
# NDK/linker settings change in a future AGP release.
target_link_options(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE
    "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384"
)

if(ANDROID_ABI STREQUAL "x86_64")
    # Zig emits general-dynamic TLS on x86_64, which needs __tls_get_addr;
    # bionic only exports it from API 29. Let it stay undefined at link time
    # (overrides AGP's --no-undefined): x86_64 is an emulator-only ABI and
    # API 29+ emulators resolve it from libc.so at load.
    target_link_options(sshhelper_terminal PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,undefs")
endif()
